notes.title: How paper results work
notes.fills: Free data is delayed and bar-based, so fills are approximate: the entry is the next bar's open plus slippage ({{pct}} + {{perShare}} per share). If stop and target are both touched in the same bar, the stop counts first; gaps fill at the bar's open.
notes.awake: Live following needs the PC on, awake and online during market hours. Closing the window keeps Levelset running in the system tray.
notes.catchup: If Levelset was closed, it replays the day's missed intervals when it starts and marks those trades "Backfilled". Only live alerts are missed.
notes.separate: Paper trades never count toward your real daily limits and never reach a broker.
